# Coding & development

AI coding assistants, browser builders, and local development tools. Some include a free quota from a vendor; others are open-source clients that use free local models or bring-your-own API keys. All generated code needs tests, review, and a security check.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **20 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Never paste API keys, passwords, patient data, or private company code into a free coding assistant without permission. Ask the assistant to explain changes, run the tests yourself, and review dependencies and licenses. A tool that generates code is not an automatic reviewer of that code.

**Start here:** [GitHub Copilot](#tool-github-copilot) · [Gemini CLI](#tool-gemini-cli) · [Continue](#tool-continue-dev)

## All 20 tools

<a id="tool-github-copilot"></a>

### GitHub Copilot

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free tier for individual developers with monthly code completions and a smaller quota of chat or premium-model requests, inside supported editors and GitHub.
- **Sign-up notes:** GitHub account; no card for the free individual plan. Eligibility checks and monthly quotas apply.
- **Limits:** Monthly completion and chat quotas are capped; premium model requests run out sooner. Business controls, organization policy, and higher limits need paid plans. Generated code still needs review.
- **Best for:** A first AI pair programmer if you already use VS Code, Visual Studio, or JetBrains.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/features/copilot>
- **Tags:** `autocomplete` `chat` `ide` `beginner`

<a id="tool-gemini-code-assist"></a>

### Gemini Code Assist

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free individual plan with code completion, chat, and code explanation in popular IDEs, including a generous monthly completion allowance.
- **Sign-up notes:** Google account; no card for the individual free plan. IDE install and request caps apply.
- **Limits:** Daily and monthly request caps apply, and premium/enterprise features are separate. Model access and data-use terms can change; review what Google may collect from free use.
- **Best for:** A generous free IDE assistant, especially for Google Cloud or JavaScript/TypeScript projects.
- **Official link:** <https://codeassist.google>
- **Tags:** `autocomplete` `chat` `ide` `google`

<a id="tool-gemini-cli"></a>

### Gemini CLI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source terminal coding agent with a free quota when you sign in with a personal Google account, including repository-aware chat and tool use.
- **Sign-up notes:** Google account sign-in for the free quota; no card. Install Node.js and review agent permissions.
- **Limits:** Free requests are rate-limited and quota-bound; higher usage needs an API key or paid plan. The agent can edit files and run commands, so use version control and review every action.
- **Best for:** Terminal-minded users who want a capable agent and will supervise its changes closely.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli>
- **Tags:** `terminal` `agent` `google` `open-source`

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

### Continue

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source assistant for VS Code and JetBrains that lets you bring a local model or your own model provider into a chat-and-autocomplete workflow.
- **Sign-up notes:** Extension install; no vendor account or card. Add a local model or your own API key.
- **Limits:** The extension is free, but model access may cost money or require capable hardware. You manage API keys, privacy, and configuration. Quality depends on the model you connect.

<a id="tool-aider"></a>

### Aider

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source command-line pair programmer that edits files in a local Git repository and works with local or remote models.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install via the official instructions; no account or card. You supply a model, which may cost money.
- **Limits:** You provide a model: local models need hardware, remote APIs cost money. Terminal comfort and Git knowledge help. It can make broad edits, so inspect diffs and run tests.
- **Best for:** Careful, Git-aware code changes on an existing project with full visibility into edits.

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free browser notebooks with CPU and limited GPU/TPU access for learning Python, testing AI models, and running data experiments.
